children: Ethan Allen Interiors has launched a search for the furniture maker's next chief executive.
Ethan Allen on Monday said it has hired an executive search firm that is identifying and evaluating internal and external candidates to succeed Farooq Kathwari as CEO of the Danbury, Conn., company.
Ethan Allen said its board has committed to announcing the company's next CEO by June 30, 2027, the date on which Kathwari's current contract is scheduled to end.
Kathwari, who is Ethan Allen's largest shareholder, has been chairman and CEO since 1988.
Ethan Allen said Kathwari will remain as a nonexecutive member of the board after June 30, and that he will step down from that role at the company's 2027 annual meeting.
